name: Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal // Temple of the Dead
clause: Whenever an opponent discards a land card, create a 1/1 black Bat creature token with flying.

needs.semantics: 'Whenever an opponent discards a land card, ...'. game.ts:2279 folds `discard` in with `life-gain` and hardcodes `ctx.player === perm.controller`, so the event can only ever be about the ability's own controller - an opponent-facing discard trigger fires on the wrong player rather than not at all.
